title: DefineButtonSound (tag 17) — button per-state sound effects
description: Tag 17 (DefineButtonSound) is completely absent: not in tags.ts, no model fields for per-state button sounds, no emit path. Flash 8 widely uses rollover/click sounds on buttons. Add SoundEffect type to ButtonItem model, emit DefineButtonSound after DefineButton2 when any state sound is set. Ruffle reads ButtonSounds { over_to_up, up_to_over, over_to_down, down_to_over }.
